description: Searches the open knowledge of KULIC Advisory behind the AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank: 25 practice questions with short answers, the purchasing glossary (184 terms) and the open patterns of the Painpoint Atlas, in German or English. Each hit names the matching Werkbank tool. Optionally adds Dario Kulić's stance on AI, change and people, paraphrased. Open without sign-in, stores nothing.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

query.description: Question or keyword, e.g. 'Wer ist für das WE/RE-Konto zuständig?', 'Incoterms DDP', 'passive approval'.

name: search_knowledge
title: Search the KULIC knowledge: question bank, glossary, Painpoint Atlas
